svg.title: Full screen: the Mac's trackpad and keys belong to Omarchy
svg.desc: Animated diagram. A MacBook shows the Omarchy VM full screen, marked as captured with a lock. Three fingers swipe on the trackpad and Omarchy changes workspace while macOS's own Spaces swipe is blocked. Command+Space opens Omarchy's launcher instead of Spotlight; volume and brightness keys still change the Mac, with Omarchy's popup. Then Control+Option+Escape is pressed: the lock opens and the monitor moves one Space over to macOS, with macOS's own animation, while the VM stays full screen in its own Space. The trackpad and keys belong to macOS now. Control+Option+Escape pressed again moves the monitor back into the VM, captured again. A setting chooses the monitor under the pointer or all monitors. A panel on the right shows where trackpad gestures, Command shortcuts and media keys go in each moment.

g.text: full screen: your trackpad and keys belong to Omarchy
⌘ Space opens Omarchy's launcher, not Spotlight
⌃ ⌥ esc moves this monitor one Space to macOS
the VM stays full screen in its own Space
⌃ ⌥ esc again: back into the VM, captured

svg.text: Only while the VM is full screen and in front.
If OmacVM Gestures stops, macOS gets its gestures back.
Setting: the monitor under the pointer, or all monitors.
